card.name: Negated lists and exclusions in labels
card.fires_on: Small linking words or punctuation inside a list of excluded or forbidden items, right after a negation such as "does not contain", "except" or "do not use". Also the start of the word "intravenously" after "never be injected".

modes.label: Joiner in a negated list
modes.description: The word "and", "or" or a comma that joins items in a list following a negation or prohibition.
modes.example: PROSOL does not contain the amino acids cysteine<< and>> taurine, considered conditionally essential

modes.label: Exception wording
modes.description: Words that introduce an exception or example after "except" or "such".
modes.example: You may search for any word except<< for>> those in the exception list

modes.label: Drug pair to avoid
modes.description: A comma or "or" between drugs that should not be combined with another drug.
modes.example: Do not use fluoxetine in combination with thioridazine<< or>> pimozide.

card.writes: It seems to push toward words meaning unsupported, unstable, confidential or unauthorized, and away from ordinary content words.
card.plain: It fires on the small word that continues a list of things that are excluded, not contained or not to be combined.
